read-model-support.purpose: Provide reusable read-model-support assets shared by multiple identity slices.
read-model-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only when capability cannot stay inside one slice and cross-slice reuse is explicit.
read-model-support.justification: read-model-support centralizes reusable context-local composition that should not duplicate across slices.
read-model-support.createdFor: Multi-slice identity workflows that need shared runtime helpers.
read-model-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when all consumers can move the behavior back into slice-local modules.
